scope: Existing Baseline raw followup, raw mixed rebinding, raw quartet replacement, and three completed repeat3 runs only; not all repository simulations.

definitions.U: Actual clipped compute/(32*window duration), no denominator normalization after drain
definitions.capacity: Inherited prior exact-time scan, bound by result SHA; this timing search does not re-run capacity scanner
definitions.posthoc: Endpoints based on observed earliest queue exhaustion and 250ms sliding grid are exploratory, not preregistered validation
definitions.qualifier: Descriptive screen: at least8s after2000ms, all32active, all32positive short+long C, U<=90.5%, inherited capacity passed
definitions.raw_rule: direct_data_row plus constructed_profile false in each frozen request load; C/V authenticity is inherited from prior audit
